name: Tryptophan-kynurenine catabolism and NAD(P)+ metabolism
rationale: All members concern NAD/NADP+ production, salvage, transport or redox use, largely from tryptophan via kynurenine and quinolinate, which separates the theme from the polyamine and coenzyme A/pyruvate confusables.

name: DNA methylation-mediated gene silencing and genomic imprinting
rationale: Members cover DNA/CpG methylation, PRC2-linked silencing, facultative heterochromatin and imprinting, whereas confusables centre on histone lysine/arginine methylation and chromatin remodelling complexes.

qualifier: ligand binding by splice isoforms and activating point mutants
name: FGFR1-3 isoform ligand binding and activating mutations
rationale: Every member is ligand binding/activation of FGFR1-3 b/c splice isoforms or signaling by activated FGFR point mutants, while confusables hold downstream FRS, SHC, PLC and PI3K cascades and FGFR4.

qualifier: definitive endoderm, lateral plate mesoderm and gut tube
name: Definitive endoderm specification, lateral mesoderm and gut morphogenesis
rationale: Members span definitive endoderm fate specification, lateral plate mesoderm formation and foregut/hindgut morphogenesis, whereas confusables focus on primitive streak, mesendoderm and gastrulation cell migration.

name: Restraint of cell proliferation in kidney development
rationale: All members concern (mostly negative) control of proliferation and progenitor maintenance in kidney/metanephros development, while confusables cover kidney size, apoptosis, ureter/nephric duct and mesenchymal-epithelial differentiation.

name: Neural progenitor division and midbrain dopaminergic neuron differentiation
rationale: Members are neuroblast/radial glia proliferation, asymmetric division and stem cell maintenance plus dopaminergic neuron differentiation, which confusables lacking dopaminergic and asymmetric-division terms do not share.

qualifier: cellular uptake and intracellular processing defects
name: Cobalamin metabolism and intracellular processing disorders
rationale: All members are cobalamin metabolism or its defects in cellular uptake (CD320) and processing (MMACHC, MMADHC), distinct from methylmalonyl-CoA mutase disorders and intestinal/plasma cobalamin transport.

name: Tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance of KIT mutants
rationale: Every member is binding of, or resistance to, a tyrosine kinase inhibitor by mutant KIT, separating it from FLT3 and PDGFR drug-resistance themes and from KIT mutant signaling.

qualifier: TRKB and TRKC via BDNF, NT-3 and NT-4
name: BDNF/NT-3 signaling through TRKB and TRKC
rationale: Members are activation of NTRK2/NTRK3 by BDNF, NT-3 and NT-4 and their downstream RAS, PI3K, PLCG1 and FRS2 effectors, whereas confusables cover NGF-TRKA signaling.

qualifier: heavy metal detoxification by metallothioneins and MTF1
name: Heavy metal ion response and metallothionein detoxification
rationale: Members are responses to cadmium, mercury, lead, cobalt, copper, zinc and other metals with MTF1-driven metallothionein binding, distinct from zinc/copper transporter homeostasis and reactive oxygen species confusables.

name: Membrane tubulation and vesicle budding in endomembrane traffic
rationale: Members concern vesicle budding, endosomal membrane tubulation, membrane docking and a broad trafficking module, whereas confusables are Golgi/COPI/COPII routes, Rab GTPase regulation, ER targeting or endocytic recycling.

name: Translation initiation and stress-induced translational control
rationale: Members are 43S/48S assembly, scanning, eIF2 recycling and 60S joining plus GCN2 and ER-stress control of initiation, distinct from rRNA transcription and from translation termination, mRNA decay and ribosome quality control.

name: Viral attachment, receptor-mediated entry and membrane fusion
rationale: Members describe virion attachment, receptor-mediated endocytosis, cell-cell fusion and entry regulation across dengue, influenza, RSV and HIV, whereas confusables cover host restriction or viral protein maturation and assembly.

qualifier: regulation of intrinsic apoptosis and p21-mediated G1 arrest
name: p53 control of DNA-damage apoptosis and G1 arrest
rationale: Members are regulation of p53-mediated intrinsic apoptosis and DNA damage signaling plus p53 expression/co-factors and p21-driven G1 arrest, while confusables hold p53 transcription of death genes or radiation/phosphorylation responses.

name: Podocyte development, epithelial polarity and microvillus assembly
rationale: Members cover podocyte/glomerular epithelial development with nephrin and albumin uptake plus apical-basal polarity and brush border assembly, distinct from glomerular endothelial/mesangial and adherens-junction confusables.

qualifier: HNF4/CDX-driven absorptive enterocytes and crypt renewal
name: HNF4/CDX-driven intestinal absorptive epithelium and crypt homeostasis
rationale: Nearly all members are intestinal (and hepatic) absorptive epithelium modules, hepatocyte nuclear factor targets and crypt stem cell homeostasis, distinct from keratinocyte, melanocyte and antimicrobial confusables.

name: Telomeric heterochromatin and ATRX/DAXX suppression of recombination
rationale: Members concern telomere packaging, subtelomeric heterochromatin, inhibition of telomeric recombination (and its ATRX/DAXX defects) and restraint of telomerase, whereas confusables cover telomere extension, capping and recombination-based maintenance.

qualifier: development, outer segment maintenance and phototransduction
name: Photoreceptor development, outer segment maintenance and phototransduction
rationale: Members combine retinal neuron and photoreceptor differentiation, outer segment/ciliary organisation and the phototransduction cascade, distinct from retinoid cycle/opsin defects and from eye morphogenesis confusables.

name: LXR-regulated triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis
rationale: Members are triglyceride synthesis, lipolysis and fatty acid homeostasis with NR1H2/NR1H3 (LXR) target gene regulation, whereas confusables centre on PPARA/SREBP, white adipocyte differentiation or glucagon-PKA signaling.

name: Chromosome condensation and CENP-A/replication-coupled nucleosome assembly
rationale: Members are mitotic/meiotic chromosome condensation and nucleosome assembly including centromeric CENP-A deposition, distinct from sister chromatid cohesion and histone acetylation confusables.

qualifier: type 1 and type 2 promoters, tRNA genes
name: RNA polymerase III initiation at type 1/2 promoters
rationale: All members are Pol III initiation at type 1/2 promoters including tRNA transcription, whereas confusables cover Pol III elongation/termination, type 3 snRNA promoters and Pol I rRNA transcription.

name: Keratinocyte differentiation, cornification and epidermal barrier formation
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation and differentiation, cornified envelope assembly and skin barrier establishment, distinct from wound healing, melanocyte and hair follicle confusables.

qualifier: nucleolar/cytosolic methylation and pseudouridylation with Cajal body targeting
name: Cytosolic RNA methylation, pseudouridylation and Cajal body targeting
rationale: Members are methylation and pseudouridylation of rRNA, tRNA, snRNA and mRNA with snoRNP assembly and scaRNA/telomerase RNA Cajal body localization, distinct from mitochondrial RNA modification and from rRNA cleavage and nuclear RNA decay.

name: Inflammatory monocyte chemotaxis, activation and aggregation
rationale: Members regulate monocyte chemotaxis, MCP-1 production, extravasation, activation and aggregation within an inflammatory cytokine response, whereas confusables are monocyte surface signatures, CCR2/CX3CR1 modules or endothelial adhesion.

name: CCR2/CX3CR1-guided monocyte and macrophage recruitment in inflammation
rationale: Members regulate monocyte and macrophage chemotaxis, MCP-1 production and activation with CCR2/CX3CR1 myeloid modules and inflammatory sensing, distinct from monocyte surface signatures, chemokine-receptor binding and endothelial adhesion confusables.
